operations.description: Read an Actor document and its unmodified dnd5e system data. Does not calculate game rules or roll dice.

actor_uuid.description: Actor UUID in the selected target world.

operations.description: Activate a built-in attack/check/save/damage/heal/utility activity and its configured resource consumption without dialogs, templates or subsequent actions. Does not perform attack/damage or apply target effects. Slot-consuming spells require an explicit available slot at exactly their base level; upcasting, concentration and specialized/custom activity types are excluded. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Apply typed damage/healing through Actor.applyDamage, preserving system rules and module hooks. Reports before/after HP and whether HP changed; a hook veto or immunity can legitimately leave it unchanged. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
Calculate typed damage/healing using the actor system resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities and modifiers. A preview, not a reservation or HP update; calculation hooks run.
List an owned or readable Item activities, exact IDs, types, resource consumption and use eligibility. Activity IDs select fixed operations; no function name is accepted.
Read one activity source and prepared targeting/consumption metadata without activating it.
Read the selected actor inventory and spell items, their prepared system data and activity IDs. No Item Piles transaction semantics are implied.
Read prepared D&D5e actor statistics, abilities, skills, spells, currencies and traits after system/module preparation.
Read actor and embedded-item ActiveEffects with suppression, disabled state and statuses; does not alter effect definitions.
Read a D&D5e Item source plus prepared system data without opening its sheet or triggering use.
Read the actor system roll data through its actual getRollData method. Document references become summaries; no formula is evaluated.
Read selected runtime D&D5e ability, skill, tool, currency, damage and condition definitions, plus active module IDs and versions. Not the complete system configuration.

Perform a system long rest without dialogs, world-time advancement or bastion turns. The system decides recovery; new_day is explicit and observed planned actor/item updates are checked. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a system ability check with prepared bonuses and hooks, with the configuration dialog disabled. Chat is opt-in. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a built-in attack activity with explicit attack mode. May consume ammunition/thrown items and update last-used flags; does not activate other resources or apply damage. Runtime token targets must be empty. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll standalone base-context damage/healing without applying it or consuming activation resources. Attack activities require explicit ability, attack_mode and ammunition_id (null for none); no prior UI/activation context is inferred. Upcasting or consumed-hit-die scaling is excluded. Chat and last damage-type flags may change. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll the formula already stored on a built-in utility activity without a dialog. No caller-supplied formula or JavaScript is accepted; activation resources are not consumed. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a system concentration saving throw at an explicit DC. The API and installed hooks determine effects; the bridge does not independently end concentration. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a death saving throw; D&D5e can update death counters and HP. Returns the roll and observed actor state, including hook-dependent changes. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Spend one hit die of an explicit denomination and apply system healing. Returns observed HP/hit-die state because hooks can prevent individual updates. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a system saving throw through Actor.rollSavingThrow. Does not guess a saving throw from a generic d20 roll. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a configured D&D5e skill using its actual actor method, including installed wrappers. Unknown skills are rejected instead of falling back to an ability check. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a configured actor tool proficiency through the D&D5e tool-check API without opening a dialog. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Set an explicit non-levelled D&D5e condition active/inactive through the actual system override and verify observed status. Levelled conditions such as exhaustion are rejected. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Perform a system short rest without dialogs, automatic hit-die spending, world-time advancement or bastion turns. new_day is explicit; planned actor/item updates are checked against observed state. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the actor in the execution runtime (or GM). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
